TI_track: Existing Trillion Insight thread, separate isolated TI branch and reviewable PR; source implementations and final shared wire are coordinated, no blanket TI merge/deploy authority.

baseline_activation.activation_gate: Verified source/images, reviewed audience/disposition, exact baseline registration, then authenticated serving discovery/metadata/reads and actual TI outcomes for every eligible dataset. Empty and unavailable datasets remain explicit; no inference from SELECT or a no-row query.
baseline_activation.baseline_candidate: Private exact 127-object inventory: 100 provisional eligible registrations, 26 excluded controls and one held relation. No registration has run in DEV.
baseline_activation.current_grants: Fresh complete existing reader policy has no missing grants. A release expecting zero grant statements must stop/rollback on unexpected drift rather than broaden its write scope.
baseline_activation.reason: A non-elevated API identity cannot classify or write enrollment metadata. Migration reconciliation does not silently label pre-existing relations eligible.
baseline_activation.transaction: Explicit reviewed owner connection and caller-owned transaction; full target metadata preflight before the first registration write. Commit only after all approved baseline registrations and permissions verify.

current_implementation.authentication: Reuse existing internal ingress and short-lived Google OIDC Cloud Run invoker authorization. TI enforces its existing signed-in partner and workload boundaries. No direct browser-to-MFData, public proxy, new key or authentication framework.
current_implementation.database_identity: Direct mfdata_verified_reader/current_user=session_user on mfdataindia; no elevation, inherited membership, database CREATE or eligible-dataset DML/DDL/grant-option capability.
current_implementation.default_image_entrypoint: The default APP Docker command now selects the additive dataset/core factory through unchanged Uvicorn flags; current image checks inspect the real Config.Cmd and exercise its factory/routes.
current_implementation.installed_business_projections: Existing current-facts and retained prior business views may depend on control inputs without exposing those inputs. Reuse the original known-policy configuration validator and full definition/owner/execution-context seals once per inventory. Only paths through those verified fixed business views exempt the control-input classification; other ownership, namespace, type, RLS, function and operator checks remain. A direct control alias or mixed direct-control path stays unavailable; changed seals fail closed.
current_implementation.legacy_domain_factory_and_contracts: Unmodified; the additive factory extends the same core application/pool and preserves its domain paths.
current_implementation.pagination: Physical primary key uses typed keyset positions. A trusted view enrollment may declare integral/date/time/UUID keys, including explicitly handled NULLS LAST; the page plus look-ahead row rejects duplicate keys before advancing a cursor. Baseline declarations require matching retained view-definition hashes. Otherwise use explicit canonical offset order. Cursors bind dataset and schema; every page is a fresh transaction, not a retained multi-page snapshot. Concurrent data changes can affect page membership. Byte-budget page shortening always returns a continuation cursor without truncating columns.
current_implementation.permissions_are_not_readiness: A dataset requires a trusted creator enrollment, safe metadata/dependency and permission checks, and an actual no-row reader projection in the discovery request. Actual TI consumption is a separate receipt, never inferred.
current_implementation.query_boundary: Each API request has repeatable-read READ ONLY, ten-second statement and five-second lock limits. Only verified server catalogue identifiers and parameterized positions/ranges reach SQL.
current_implementation.sensitive_data: Known internal controls/held raw transport record are never discoverable or retrievable even if marked. Sensitive column names and detected credential-bearing nested values fail closed with value-free reasons. Trusted eligibility review remains necessary; the detector is not a universal arbitrary-secret classifier.
current_implementation.types: Built-in pg_catalog scalar/array types only. int8/numeric and date/time/UUID scalar columns are serialized as strings; bytea is a typed bounded content reference. No silent column projection or truncated row response.

future_enrollment.atomicity: The caller owns the outer transaction. Per-relation savepoints contain failed reconciliation; no hidden COMMIT, alternate connection or retry. Structured IDs/reasons make failures observable without rolling back unrelated ingestion values.
future_enrollment.creator_schema_matrix: The existing sixteen RO01 schemas retain mfdata_admin direct ownership; do not weaken those guards or transfer ownership. Additional eligible research schemas support direct mfdata_admin or mfdata_ingest creators. An mfdata_ingest-owned relation in an existing RO01 schema is explicitly unsupported and rejected before registration, not silently certified; no role gains CREATE/ownership/membership from this sprint.
future_enrollment.grants: Only missing USAGE for the enrolled object's schema and SELECT for the enrolled owned relation, fixed reader, no grant options. No ownership/membership/role/default-global/function/sequence mutation or new writer capability. Current schema-local defaults remain unchanged.
future_enrollment.idempotence: Identical enrollment emits no metadata write; already-compliant reconciliation emits no GRANT. Discovery is dynamic from verified current metadata, not a fixed TI list.
future_enrollment.lifecycle: Trusted creator invokes datasets.enrollment.enroll on its real owned relation after DDL. Existing scripts/migrate.py invokes isolated reconciliation after its existing successful work. Other supported programmatic enrollment callers invoke the same hook; bypassing the lifecycle is reported unready, not presumed covered.
future_enrollment.metadata: Versioned creator-owned PostgreSQL relation comment; optional non-executable view-key declaration, preserve unrelated existing documentation, reject ambiguous duplicate markers, no caller SQL or target-role field.
future_enrollment.no_blanket_future_claim: Unregistered/unsupported creators, unsafe dependencies/types or incomplete grants never become consumer-ready. Future eligible enrollment is not automatic exposure of every newly created database object.
future_enrollment.supported_schemas: Current mf and mf_* research-domain schemas, including newly created eligible schemas; no system/unrelated schema wildcard.
